what: A dark pill at bottom center — scroll the document past 17% and it rises −40→40px (spring .4s bounce .2), pressing it opens the panel, and while scrolling inside, it switches immediately to the icon·width of the last item that passed the screen center (spring .5s bounce .3), with the title fading out at 4px blur in .15s and the new title resolving in .15s after .1s. Pressing again or Esc closes it and returns to the original title·width. On first attach the width springs from +32px to its own width

options.panel: css selector for the scroll panel to open and close — the [data-fx-part inside it=item] entry (data-title·data-width·data-icon=<template id>) counted. When open, the panel and pill get is-fx-open, fx:open/fx:close, and fx:item when the item changes (detail.index·item)
options.at: Rises when document progress exceeds this value, default .17
options.rise · bounce: Rising spring length and bounce, default .4 · .2 — 0 means instant
options.swap · lag: Title blur change duration · new title delay (s), default .15 · .1
options.width · from: Rest width / initial width (px), default current width · width+32
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Title cell — the first text is the resting title
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: (Optional) Icon slot visible only when open
options.[data-fx-part=knob]: (Optional) Round button on the right — closed 45° (＋), open 0° (×)
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Press area (button covering the whole pill)

use: See work×

from.where: index.html .rb-island-wrap — original framer-motion: bottom ±40 spring .4/.2 (when paragraph cell 20 turns on), width spring .5/.3 first 180→148, title AnimatePresence wait blur 4px .15 easeOut, setTimeout 100ms, and the video inside the overlay is whichever video’s top enters below scrollY + half the window height

note: In the original, paragraph words rise in order of cell index — the part takes the same spot by document progress (at). The curtain that opens and closes the panel and the body scroll lock live on the consumer side (fx:open/close)
